name_jp: 富士ユナイトホールディングス
summary_en: Fuji United Holdings executed a fixed-price ToSTNeT-3 purchase of 190,000 shares (2.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,234 yen per share on November 9, 2026, totaling approximately 234.5 million yen. The purchase is the first tranche of a broader buyback authorization approved on the same date for up to 342,000 shares (5.2% of outstanding) for up to 500 million yen through November 2027, to be followed by open market purchases.
summary_jp: 11月9日の立会外買付取引（ToSTNeT-3）で190,000株（発行済株式数に対する2.9%）を1,234円で買付けし、約2億3,446万円を費消。同日決議の取得枠342,000株・上限5億円のうち、残る152,000株以上は3月31日までの市場買付けで取得予定。

name_jp: 富士ユナイトホールディングス
summary_en: Interim dividend of JPY 25 per share and full-year dividend of JPY 55 per share (previously JPY 30), representing increases of JPY 5 and JPY 15 respectively. Full-year EPS guidance raised to JPY 121.16 from JPY 90.92, reflecting stronger performance in energy and green segments.
summary_jp: 中間配当1株当たり25円、期末配当予想55円（前回30円）に決定。中間配当は前回20円から5円増、期末配当は15円増。通期1株当たり当期純利益予想を90.92円から121.16円に上方修正。
tag_jp: 中間配当および期末配当の増配決定
